_readme: Edit this file to change the WhatsApp number, hours, delivery areas or which restaurants are open. Prices in cents (1295 = f12.95).
name: Order Aruba
payment: We take cash in florins or US dollars, or a bank transfer.
_status_help: status can be open, soon (shows 'Opening soon', can't order) or hidden (not shown on the home page).
_hours_help: Each day is [opens, closes] in Aruba time. A closing time earlier than the opening time means after midnight (22:00 to 02:00 = 10 PM until 2 AM the next morning).
_lastOrder_help: lastOrder: new orders stop at this time (Aruba time); the sign shows Last orders in the final 30 minutes. Remove the line for no cut-off.
_payWith_help: payWith: the ways to pay that customers tap at checkout; the choice goes on the WhatsApp ticket as "Pay: ...". Remove it to show only the payment sentence.
_payment_help: payment: one sentence on how to pay. With payWith it shows under the pay choices at checkout and in How ordering works.
